senses.gloss: † ऋक्ष् ऋक्ष् (?), ii. 5, Par. To kill or hurt.

ऋक्ष ऋक्ष,
 I. m. A bear, Rām. 3, 52, 45.
 II. f. क्षी, A she-bear, Rām. 1, 16, 21.
 III. m. and n.
 1. A star, Rām. 5, 73, 57; MBh. 13, 625.
 2. Bears and stars, Śiś. 9, 31.
 IV. m. and f. क्षा, Proper names, MBh. 1, 3722; 3790.
 --Cf. ἄρκτος; Lat. ursus.
ऋक्षवन्त् ऋक्ष + वन्त्, m. The name of a mountain, Rām. 6, 3, 10.
ऋक्ष- + राज ऋक्ष- + राज, m. 1. the king of the bears, Rām. 6, 6, 12. 2. the king of the stars, epithet of the moon, Vikr. 39, 15.
ऋक्सामशृङ्ग ऋक्सामशृङ्ग, i. e. ऋच्-सामन्-, m. a name of Viṣṇu, Rām. 6, 102, 17.
